description: Multiplies a voltage and adds a whole number of volts to it, for fitting a signal into a chosen span of octaves

params.text: Multiplies the input by 0 to 2, in steps of 0.1
Adds a whole number of volts to the scaled signal, -3V to 3V, which moves a pitch signal by that many octaves

inputs.text: The voltage being scaled, 16 channels at most

outputs.text: The input multiplied by the scale knob with the offset knob added, clamped to -10V to 10V
